verdict.rationale: Alloy's own marketing claims it streamlines perpetual KYC/KYB and AML checks, which covers screening business entities at a glancing level. Nothing in the pack shows inspecting beneficial ownership, related parties, or association risk; the entity-merging and external-ID docs concern record management, not ownership links. Missing for 10: documented KYB screening workflow detail, beneficial-ownership/UBO or linked-party risk views, association graph inspection, independent corroboration.
